about_the_game:
Dungeons & Meows: Hero Cats is a relaxing cat-themed hidden object game set in a medieval feline fantasy world.

Explore medieval villages, ancient ruins, enchanted forests, and dungeons as you activate heroic abilities and rescue cats that are trapped, injured, or bewitched among magical traps and puzzles.

Each level presents unique challenges — vigilant guards, adventurers asking for help to overcome dangerous traps, tyrants oppressing innocent kittens, and mysterious cats waiting to be rescued.

Features
• 500+ cats to find
• Hero Cats — Druid, Warrior, and Rogue, each with unique abilities (Stealth, Healing, Potions, and Strength)
• Use heroic abilities to free special kittens
• Collect ingredients in each scene to craft and upgrade heroic skills
• Hand-drawn environments full of secrets and stories
• Hint system to locate hidden cats
• Zoom feature to inspect every detail
• Relaxing music and the sounds of meows and adventure
• Save and load system
• Steam achievements and unlockable special cats

Meet the Feline Heroes
Rogue — Picks locks, disarms traps, and acts from the shadows.
Druid — Heals, thaws, and locates spiritual cats.
Warrior — Confronts enemies and saves oppressed kittens.

Get ready for a journey filled with heroic meows, magic, and mystery.

Can you find — and save — all the cats from the dungeons?
